cases.title: Exact target
cases.fault: Two sessions share a harness, host and repository; select the non-recent target.
cases.expected: Deliver only to the registered native target; sibling gets no invocation.

cases.title: Stale binding
cases.fault: Fork, restart, rename or replace a target while an older binding remains cached.
cases.expected: Reject or hold the stale binding; preserve historical attribution and do not silently retarget.

cases.title: Authentication and workload binding
cases.fault: Use unknown/revoked keys, wrong audience, an unsupported asserted session identity, or a valid workload credential with a missing/expired grant or disallowed operation/resource.
cases.expected: Refuse native dispatch; a device signature does not prove a logical agent or operator.

cases.title: Provenance and authority laundering
cases.fault: Peer content claims owner approval or arrives through a native user-role delivery API.
cases.expected: Preserve peer provenance; issue no human grant or expanded permission.

cases.title: Submission idempotency
cases.fault: Discard a response after journal commit; retry the same command and then alter its content.
cases.expected: Return original IDs for identical content; changed content under the used identity conflicts.

cases.title: Competing dispatchers
cases.fault: Race two dispatchers or resume an old dispatcher after apparent ownership expiry.
cases.expected: Prevent competing invocation; uncertain previous dispatch blocks automatic reassignment.

cases.title: Crash after durable import
cases.fault: Terminate after durable recipient import but before native dispatch.
cases.expected: Recover exactly the pending delivery; cursor progress does not erase it.

cases.title: Uncertain native invocation
cases.fault: Terminate after native invocation but before a durable dispatch receipt.
cases.expected: Resolve from native evidence or hold; do not invoke again merely because the response is absent.

cases.title: Lost target acknowledgement
cases.fault: Target accepts but its acknowledgement is lost.
cases.expected: Recover linked native acceptance evidence without repeating the requested work to obtain a new ACK.

cases.title: Incomplete or malformed replay
cases.fault: Reach the replay page cap; stall/backtrack the cursor; omit or corrupt pagination fields.
cases.expected: Fail closed with no caught-up/delivery success verdict over unread history.

cases.title: Notification and stream recovery
cases.fault: Duplicate/reorder/drop notices or change journal stream identity.
cases.expected: Reconcile through authorized replay; imported historical requests do not automatically execute.

cases.title: Busy or unavailable target
cases.fault: Make the exact target busy, asleep, offline or approval-blocked.
cases.expected: Persist a bounded pending/blocked disposition; no substitute, silent fork or automatic approval.

cases.title: Boundary and injection handling
cases.fault: Send malformed envelopes, shell syntax, unauthorized tools or a corrupt referenced artifact.
cases.expected: Reject invalid data; payload text cannot become an executable command or native lifecycle instruction.

cases.title: Canonical work ownership
cases.fault: Two recipients acknowledge correspondence about the same work/revision.
cases.expected: Existing work authority resolves execution ownership; routing ACKs cannot create conflicting grants.

cases.title: Unknown outward effect
cases.fault: Lose an effect response when the effect may already have occurred.
cases.expected: Hold affected work until reconciliation; timeout does not permit conflicting retry/publication.

cases.title: Time, fairness and recursion
cases.fault: Jump clocks, leave the journal quiet, flood background traffic or generate recursive replies.
cases.expected: Code enforces declared deadlines/queue/loop limits and reports due work; no model evaluates these terms.

cases.title: Resource privacy and direct API access
cases.fault: Request another principal's bodies, attachments, replay or notifications; try the API without the adapter.
cases.expected: Enforce service-side denial under the strict profile; no secret canaries in wake/status/log output; no device-key fallback.

cases.title: Forged completion and proof verdict
cases.fault: Claim completion with missing/wrong native or artifact evidence, or substitute a model-authored PASS.
cases.expected: Keep it an attributed claim; independent code refuses verified success; semantic quality remains separately assessed.

cases.title: Revocation, stop and expiry
cases.fault: Revoke/stop/expire a grant before dispatch or between admitted steps; submit a late result.
cases.expected: Prevent newly unauthorized work; preserve late evidence without reopening authority; meet the declared connection reauthorization bound.

cases.title: Unsupported native capability
cases.fault: Remove required APIs/MCP configuration or use an unqualified native version/surface.
cases.expected: Return explicit unsupported/blocked outcome; no session/provider/permission downgrade or CLI-for-Desktop substitution.

cases.title: Classical workflow has no inference
cases.fault: Run a classical task or request a model to decide a schema/hash/grant/count/deadline/test condition.
cases.expected: Record zero inference attempts; unknown workflow classification is held instead of inferred by a model.

cases.title: Every internal inference is governed
cases.fault: Have the native runtime retry, compact, spawn a subagent or request an evaluator model.
cases.expected: Every inference-shaped request is admitted/accounted or refused at the same boundary; none escapes the profile.

cases.title: Egress and credential bypass
cases.fault: Bypass the gateway via a forbidden network canary or reuse sibling/parent/provider credentials.
cases.expected: Deny bypass and credential reuse under the declared isolation boundary; record evidence without any real inference.

cases.title: Atomic cross-runner budget
cases.fault: Race requests from both Macs and attempt to reset consumption using a new request ID.
cases.expected: Enforce grant/exchange-wide limits atomically; uncertainty does not reset reserved/consumed authority.

cases.title: Harness portability
cases.fault: Run the same deterministic canonical fixtures through every qualified adapter.
cases.expected: Canonical receipts match after declared normalization; native statuses do not redefine meaning and live text reproducibility is not assumed.

mutations.requiredBehavioralFailure: An unintended/sibling native target receives an invocation.
A disallowed principal or operation dispatches.
A repeated identical command creates another message/work submission.

mutations.change: Retry an uncertain native invocation automatically
mutations.requiredBehavioralFailure: A second invocation starts without reconciliation.

mutations.change: Treat a capped/incomplete replay as complete
mutations.requiredBehavioralFailure: The consumer reports caught-up/success with unread history.
A request beyond the grant/exchange ceiling reaches the emulator.
A forbidden network canary is reached.

mutations.change: Convert a relayed user-role turn into human authority
mutations.requiredBehavioralFailure: Peer text acquires a human grant or expanded permissions.

counterDefinitions.inferenceAttempts: inference-shaped requests observed at the controlled boundary; emulator requests are explicitly labelled
counterDefinitions.realProviderInferenceRequests: requests issued to a real model provider for inference, excluding emulators

required.passedRequiredCaseVariants: all predeclared variants of R01–R25 across their coverage sets; frozen manifest and exact execution counts required

missing: approved test seams and finite operating bounds

proposedPilotBounds.budgetScope: one grant/exchange globally across both runners; new request IDs do not reset it
